oddities: dashboard/page.tsx and requirements/page.tsx are pure redirect('/planner') server components with zero markup; only planner and statistics carry design.

Page title scale differs: planner h1 is text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 (solid), statistics h1 is text-3xl font-bold with a .text-gradient span (135deg #153974 -> #3069B3 -> #00AACA). No shared page-header component.
Page container strategy differs: statistics wraps itself in container mx-auto px-4 py-8 max-w-7xl; planner root is just space-y-6 and relies on the layout for gutters.

Two spinner implementations: planner uses a CSS border spinner (animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-[#3069B3]; mini h-3 w-3 border-gray-600), statistics uses lucide Loader2 w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-[#3069B3].
Add Semester uses an inline heroicons-style SVG plus (w-5 h-5 mr-2) instead of lucide Plus, while every other icon on these pages is lucide-react.

CATEGORY_LABELS and CATEGORY_COLORS are defined locally in statistics/page.tsx; planner imports GRADUATION_CATEGORY_LABELS from src/lib/graduationDelta.ts (which re-exports a CATEGORY_LABELS). Duplicated semantic map.

Gradient direction varies: buttons/chips use bg-gradient-to-r from-[#153974] to-[#3069B3]; rank circles and letter avatars use bg-gradient-to-br from-[#153974] to-[#3069B3]; progress fill uses a 3-stop bg-gradient-to-r from-[#153974] via-[#3069B3] to-[#00AACA]. #00AACA appears only in the progress bar and .text-gradient on these pages.

Off-brand amber palette (bg-amber-50/200/600/700, text-amber-600/800/900) used for the guest CTA banner on the same page as brand-gradient buttons; the amber button (bg-amber-600 + text-white, text-sm) is roughly 3:1 contrast, borderline for small text.

Color collision: planner minor-major badge is bg-orange-100 text-orange-700, identical to the statistics 전공선택 (major_elective) category badge; planner double-major badge uses purple-100/700 while statistics 교직 uses violet-100/700 (purple vs violet mix).
Green vs emerald mix: planner 이수 legend chip is bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700, statistics 교양선택 badge is bg-green-100 text-green-700.
red vs rose mix in category badges: major_required bg-red-100 text-red-700 next to major_compulsory bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 (very similar hues for adjacent categories).

Border utilities without a color token (border, border-t, border-b, divide-y, border-dashed border-2) rely on Tailwind v4's default border color (currentColor unless globals.css overrides) — risk of dark borders if the base layer does not set one.

Arbitrary one-off values: text-[11px] (year filter label), text-[10px] (status legend), min-w-[140px] (export menu), w-[250px] (drag overlay), min-h-[400px] (loading/error areas), scrollMarginTop '72px' and -72 in JS (sticky header height magic number), imperative style.minWidth = '768px' during export.

Low contrast: text-gray-400 on white for the '학과를 설정해주세요' link, '({n}학점)' suffix, '학년' toolbar label, 'ㆍ클릭하여 변경' hint (text-[10px] text-gray-400 — tiny AND low contrast), and text-xs text-gray-400 footnote; text-gray-300 Users icon is decorative only.

Hover feedback inconsistent: gradient buttons use hover:opacity-90, amber button hover:bg-amber-700, chips hover:bg-gray-200, outlined buttons invert (hover:bg-[#3069B3] hover:text-white), year pills hover:bg-[#153974]/20.
Two chip sizes in the same filter card: category chips px-4 py-2 (base 16px text), semester chips px-3 py-1.5 text-sm.
Ranking rows have hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors but no click handler (hover affordance without action).
No focus-visible styles on any hand-rolled button (chips, pills, menu items, plan tiles, show-more); only the shared Button component may provide them.

Destructive reset uses native window.confirm instead of a design-system dialog, and gets its danger look by overriding Button variant='outline' with text-red-600 border-red-300 hover:bg-red-50 rather than a dedicated variant.
uppercase tracking-wide applied to Korean year headings ({year}학년) — has no effect on Hangul, suggests copied English eyebrow pattern.
Year-filter pill className template literal contains a literal newline and indentation whitespace between base classes and the ternary (harmless but untidy).
Empty/error state h2s (text-2xl font-bold mb-2) carry no text color and inherit; sibling body copy is text-gray-600.

Punctuation inconsistency: some 합니다체 sentences end with a period ('해당 조건에 맞는 과목이 없습니다.', '잠시 후 다시 시도해주세요.') while sibling messages do not ('아직 수강 계획 데이터가 없습니다'). Loading copy uses ASCII '...' not '…'. One exclamation mark and one 해요체 '~어요' sentence amid otherwise 합니다체/하세요체 copy.

Planner layout contradicts the expected 'horizontal scroll of semester columns + sidebar catalog': the catalog is a full-width row above, semesters are a grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 grouped by year, and the only horizontally scrolling element is the year-filter pill row (overflow-x-auto). Sticky behaviour, if any, lives inside CourseCatalog/RequirementsSummary (not in this file) — the page only exposes scrollMarginTop: 72px for it.

No stat-tile number typography: statistics tiles are plain font-semibold title + text-sm value; the only data visualization is a gradient horizontal bar (h-2) per ranked course — no ring charts or bar charts on these pages.
Statistics planner 'rank' uses index+1 of the *filtered* list, so rank numbers restart at 1 whenever a filter is applied.
